public.heroEyebrow: BizTrade Africa — Complete Multi-Tenant Business Platform
public.heroDesc: An all-in-one business-management platform designed to help African businesses manage, grow, and expand their operations—from Point of Sale and multi-branch inventory to customers, suppliers, employees, finances, and commercial trade.
public.heroImgAlt: Retail and wholesale business operations running on BizTrade Africa
public.aboutImgAlt: Store manager verifying product inventory and operations
public.aboutTitle: Engineered to replace fragmented notebooks and spreadsheets with structured control
public.aboutDesc: BizTrade Africa is an all-in-one business-management platform designed to help African businesses manage, grow, and expand their operations. Instead of juggling separate notebooks, disconnected POS terminals, and scattered spreadsheets across retail, wholesale, pharmacy, hardware, hospitality, and service teams, everyone works inside one governed multi-tenant workspace.
public.problemsDesc: Eliminates untracked stock shrinkage, manual receipt errors, unclear cash and mobile money balances, and delays in coordinating branch staff.
public.productivityDesc: Improves accountability with role-based permissions, audit logs, task assignments, and clear daily profit and operational visibility.
public.readFullAbout: Read full About Us & Developer Profile
public.featuresTitle: Seventeen integrated modules for complete commercial operations
public.featuresDesc: Every department—from front-counter sales, purchasing, and warehouse inventory to finance, staff tasks, and customer ordering—operates on shared, consistent data.

features.title: Business Management
features.desc: Organize company identity, currency defaults, tax rules, operating hours, and daily governance in one isolated workspace.

features.title: POS
features.desc: Process counter sales quickly with product search, barcode lookup, split payments, and printable customer receipts.

features.title: Inventory
features.desc: Track real-time stock quantities, low-stock alerts, stock adjustments, and inter-branch inventory transfers.

features.title: Products
features.desc: Maintain structured SKU catalogs, categories, pricing tiers, cost tracking, and active product listings.

features.title: Finance
features.desc: Record revenue, cost of goods sold, operating expenses with approval workflows, and live profit visibility.

features.title: Employees
features.desc: Assign staff to branches with role-based permissions covering managers, cashiers, accountants, payroll, and inventory teams.

features.title: Branches
features.desc: Run multiple store locations under one business account with branch-level inventory, sales, and staff separation.

features.title: Customers
features.desc: Build verified customer profiles, monitor receivables and loyalty records, and manage customer inquiries cleanly.

features.title: Suppliers
features.desc: Track vendor contacts, purchase histories, and outstanding supplier payables across all business branches.

features.title: Orders
features.desc: Receive customer orders from the public directory and guide them smoothly from confirmation through delivery.

features.title: Purchases
features.desc: Issue supplier purchase orders, log partial or full deliveries, verify stock intake, and settle supplier invoices cleanly.

features.title: Reports
features.desc: Review daily, monthly, and yearly performance summaries, branch comparisons, and exportable operational reports.

features.title: Communication
features.desc: Keep employees aligned with internal branch messaging channels and business-wide announcements.

features.title: Tasks
features.desc: Assign operational tasks to team members, set deadlines and priorities, and collaborate via task comments.

features.title: Advertising
features.desc: Upload and publish promotional videos with product links and thumbnails directly to your public storefront.

features.title: AI Assistant
features.desc: Ask natural business questions grounded in your own operational sales, stock, and branch records.

features.title: Notifications
features.desc: Stay informed about low inventory, incoming customer orders, expense approvals, and security updates.

public.howTitle: Structured governance from onboarding to daily trade
public.howDesc: Businesses are verified and registered by the Platform Super Admin so every workspace starts with clean isolation, assigned leadership, and verified customer visibility.

featuresPageModules.title: Business Management
featuresPageModules.desc: Centralized multi-tenant workspace governance covering company branding, RWF/regional currencies, VAT rules, operating hours, and security settings.

featuresPageModules.desc: Instant product search & barcode lookup, authorized discounts, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Cash, Card, partial payments, and printable receipts.

featuresPageModules.title: Inventory & Stock Transfers
featuresPageModules.desc: Every stock change writes an immutable stock movement record with transactional locking to prevent overselling across branches.

featuresPageModules.desc: Manage SKUs, barcodes, categories, cost and retail prices, minimum stock thresholds, product photography, and catalog publication.

featuresPageModules.desc: Track sales revenue, COGS, gross profit, non-sales income, operating expenses with manager approval workflows, and cash flow.

featuresPageModules.desc: Invite staff with custom RBAC permissions, manage branch assignments, configure recurring salary schedules, and process payroll payouts.

featuresPageModules.title: Multi-Branch Operations
featuresPageModules.desc: Operate headquarters and regional retail outlets under one account with isolated branch stock, cashiers, and manager reporting.

featuresPageModules.title: Customer Management (CRM)
featuresPageModules.desc: Maintain verified retail and wholesale customer profiles, track credit balances, loyalty points, and customer service notes.

featuresPageModules.title: Supplier Management
featuresPageModules.desc: Centralize vendor directories, contact persons, tax identifiers, supply history, and outstanding supplier payables.

featuresPageModules.title: Customer Order Fulfillment
featuresPageModules.desc: Receive online directory orders from verified customers and track status progression cleanly through confirmation and delivery.

featuresPageModules.title: Purchases & Goods Receiving
featuresPageModules.desc: Create purchase orders for suppliers, log physical goods received per branch, update weighted stock costs, and record supplier payments.

featuresPageModules.title: Reports & Data Exports
featuresPageModules.desc: Analyze daily, monthly, and annual P&L trends, top-selling products, branch breakdowns, and export full CSV operational reports.

featuresPageModules.title: Internal Business Communication
featuresPageModules.desc: Coordinate branch teams with real-time workspace messaging channels, shift handovers, and company-wide announcements.

featuresPageModules.title: Operational Task Management
featuresPageModules.desc: Delegate branch operational tasks with priority levels, due dates, progress tracking, and team comment threads.

featuresPageModules.title: Promotional Video Advertising
featuresPageModules.desc: Upload and publish chunk-resilient promotional videos linked to store products directly to the public BizTrade Africa showcase.

featuresPageModules.title: AI Business Assistant
featuresPageModules.desc: Query operational trends, low-stock priorities, and sales performance using natural language grounded in live workspace data.

featuresPageModules.title: Real-Time Notifications
featuresPageModules.desc: Instant alerts for low inventory thresholds, new online customer orders, expense approvals, tasks, and account security events.

public.pricingSubtitle: Businesses are onboarded and verified by Platform Super Admin. Contact our team to provision your business workspace.
public.aboutPageDesc: BizTrade Africa is an all-in-one business-management platform designed to help African businesses manage, grow, and expand their operations across Rwanda and East Africa on one reliable commercial cloud platform.
public.rwandaEngineeringDesc: Configured out of the box with Rwandan Franc (RWF), +250 phone validation, Africa/Kigali timezone, configurable VAT rates, and MTN MoMo / Airtel Money tracking.
public.continentalGrowthDesc: Multi-country localization settings allow businesses expanding into Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Ghana, or Nigeria to configure regional currencies and tax rules in seconds.
public.devSectionDesc: Designed and engineered with a focus on dependable transaction records, clean multi-tenant isolation, and accessible commercial tooling.
public.defaultDevBio: Full Stack Developer at softworld specializing in multi-tenant commercial platforms, relational database architecture, and responsive web applications built for African businesses and digital retail—including BizTradeAfrica, Kigali-Store, and ElectroVault.
public.projectVisionDesc: Equip growing African businesses and digital storefronts with dependable stock tracking, transparent accounting, and structured hiring workflows without unnecessary complexity.
public.techSkillsDesc: Core programming languages, application frameworks, databases, and engineering workflow tools.
public.projectDescBiztrade: An African-focused business and employment platform designed to connect businesses, customers, traders and job seekers.
public.projectDescKigali: An electronics e-commerce platform for managing products, customers, shopping activities, orders and business operations.
public.projectDescElectro: A modern electronics shopping platform focused on providing customers with an organized and convenient electronics shopping experience.
public.contactPageSubtitle: Request new business registration, enterprise onboarding, branch hardware advice, or custom support. Inquiries are routed directly to
public.trackOrderSubtitle: Enter your order number and phone number to check live fulfillment and delivery status.
public.legalP1: BizTrade Africa operates as a multi-tenant commercial software platform with strict data isolation. Each registered business owns all operational records, product catalogs, customer data, and financial transactions created inside its workspace.
public.legalP2: When a subscription expires, BizTrade Africa preserves tenant records under defined grace-period and retention policies rather than deleting business history unexpectedly. Platform administrators never receive unrestricted access to private tenant financial entries.
